01029b0c1989.name: Hacking Advance
01029b0c1989.plain: In the Fight phase, every unmodified hit roll of 6 for Gotfret de Montbard's attacks scores 2 hits rather than 1.

035405e2c7a9.name: Stonetooth
035405e2c7a9.plain: Roll a D6 whenever this model is about to lose a wound; on a 5+, the wound isn't lost.

0501e1e1b66c.name: Deathstrike Missile
0501e1e1b66c.plain: In the Muster Armies step, after seeing your opponent's army roster, pick a warhead for this model: godspear, plasma barrage or vortex warhead. Note your choice on your army roster.

07cedde59045.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
07cedde59045.plain: During deployment, you can have this unit ride around the flanks rather than placing it on the battlefield. It can then join the battle at the end of any of your Movement phases: set it up with all its models within 7" of a battlefield edge you choose and more than 9" from all enemy models.

087db1d06021.name: Grinding Advance
087db1d06021.plain: This model can fire its turret weapon twice in the following Shooting phase if it Remained Stationary or moved under half speed in its Movement phase. Moving under half speed means moving fewer inches than half its current Move characteristic. Both times, the turret weapon must target the same unit. Turret weapons are the battle cannon, the Conqueror battle cannon, the demolisher cannon, the Eradicator nova cannon, the Executioner plasma cannon, the Exterminator autocannon, the Punisher gatling cannon, the Stygies Vanquisher battle cannon, the twin lascannon and the Vanquisher battle cannon.

0bdeb1a97836.name: Tanith Camo-cloak
0bdeb1a97836.plain: Ranged attacks can't target this unit if it is more than 18" away from the firing unit. Ranged attacks made against this unit subtract 1 from their hit roll. If the unit is receiving the benefits of cover, add a further 1 to armour saving throws against ranged attacks allocated to its models.

10c307622b0d.name: Senior Officer
10c307622b0d.plain: In each of your turns, this model can use the Voice of Command ability twice. Resolve the first order's effects before issuing the second.

1150abd96966.name: Melta Mine
1150abd96966.plain: The bearer gets the MELTA MINE keyword.

12bd58015b85.name: Colonel CoIm Corbec
12bd58015b85.plain: Once per battle round, if Colonel Colm Corbec is part of this unit, an Astra Militarum or Core Stratagem that selects this unit costs 1 CP less to use (minimum 0 CP). The reduction applies only to that one use; later uses cost the normal amount.

133b23e1ddc7.name: Magma Cannon
133b23e1ddc7.plain: This weapon has the Blast and Turret Weapon abilities. Attacks made with it that target a unit within half range have a Damage characteristic of D6+4.

141897a8074a.name: Hidden Ambush
141897a8074a.plain: During deployment, you can put Sly Marbo in ambush rather than on the battlefield. If you do, he arrives in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases: set this unit up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. You can re-roll charge rolls for this model until that turn ends.

14394694c6e6.name: Defense Searchlight
14394694c6e6.plain: Whenever this model is chosen to shoot, pick an enemy unit within 48"; one of your units adds 1 to its ranged hit rolls against that enemy unit this phase. The enemy unit must be visible to this model and within 48" of it. The unit that gets the bonus is one you pick from your <REGIMENT> INFANTRY and <REGIMENT> SABRE WEAPONS BATTERY units, and it can't be one already picked for this ability this turn. The bonus lasts until the end of the phase and applies to each ranged attack a model in that unit makes against that enemy unit.

198609c8f7dc.name: Death Korps Medi-pack
198609c8f7dc.plain: Once per turn, the first time a model in the bearer's unit fails a saving throw, change that attack's Damage characteristic to 0. The bearer also gains the MEDIC keyword.

1afb23ef39f2.name: Stormblade plasma blastgun – supercharge
1afb23ef39f2.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability. For each unmodified hit roll of 1 made for an attack with this profile, the bearer suffers 3 mortal wounds once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

1b7a60414292.name: Tactical Genius
1b7a60414292.plain: As long as this model is on the battlefield, the Command Re-roll Stratagem can be used up to two times in each phase, not just once.

1dbe3c881d18.name: Make Way
1dbe3c881d18.plain: When this model piles in or consolidates, it can move up to 3" further.

1f168e3da529.name: Aura of Discipline
1f168e3da529.plain: Your ASTRA MILITARUM units that are within 6" of a COMMISSAR can use his Leadership rather than their own.

210b04d7d9af.name: Align Target
210b04d7d9af.plain: This model can perform the Align Target action. Align Target (Action): in your Command phase, you can have any number of your DEATHSTRIKE models that haven't launched their missile start this action. It completes at the end of your turn. When it completes, you must do one of these: (1) place a Deathstrike Target marker for the model that completed it anywhere on the battlefield; or (2) if that model already has a Deathstrike Target marker on the battlefield, move that marker anywhere on the battlefield.

216cda33dd21.name: Gaunt's Ghosts
216cda33dd21.plain: Your ASTRA MILITARUM units can't issue orders to this unit. This unit can make ranged attacks while performing an action without the action failing.

21e370e2c01c.name: Volkite Caliver
21e370e2c01c.plain: On an unmodified wound roll of 6, attacks made with this weapon also inflict 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of any normal damage.

2486d36725a4.name: Shoot Sharp and Scarper
2486d36725a4.plain: Once per turn, this unit can make a Normal Move after it has shot. If that move happens after resolving Overwatch, your opponent can choose new targets for that charge.

25478d0515a3.name: Commanding Authority
25478d0515a3.plain: This model knows Regimental, Prefectus and Mechanised Orders, and can issue up to three Orders in your Command phase. Besides the usual eligible units, it can also issue Regimental and Prefectus Orders to your INFANTRY OFFICER and MILITARUM AUXILLA units, and Mechanised Orders to your VEHICLE OFFICER and SUPER-HEAVY units.

254a9e235e6e.name: Harker's Hellraisers
254a9e235e6e.plain: Before deployment, pick one CATACHAN JUNGLE FIGHTERS unit in your army. For the rest of the battle, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 when making attacks.

2914216a222c.name: Auspex Surveyor
2914216a222c.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit visible to this model and within 24" of it. Until the end of the phase, this model gains this ability: Enemy Sighted (Aura): while one of your <REGIMENT> VEHICLE units is within 6" of this model, the picked enemy unit gets no benefit of cover against attacks made by that unit's models.

2d85a95ea597.name: Lord Commander Solar
2d85a95ea597.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your units within 6" of this model that is ASTRA MILITARUM CORE, ASTRA MILITARUM CHARACTER or ASTRA MILITARUM BATTLE TANK. Until the start of your next Command phase, the hit roll can be re-rolled for attacks made by that unit's models; for a CORE unit, the wound roll can be re-rolled too.

2ffaf200f462.name: Point-blank Barrage
2ffaf200f462.plain: Even while its unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, this model can shoot its ripper gun, but its targets must be enemy units that its own unit is in Engagement Range of. When it does, it can target such an enemy unit even if other friendly units are also in Engagement Range of it.

30680f52cf5f.name: Omnissiah's Blessing
30680f52cf5f.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE models within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model has a 5+ invulnerable save until the start of your next Command phase.

309450bbe553.name: Brute Shield
309450bbe553.plain: The bearer has an invulnerable save of 4+.

3204b0599290.name: Aerial Drop
3204b0599290.plain: During deployment, you can set this unit up in a high altitude transport rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

327174f26bf8.name: Explodes (6+/3"/1)
327174f26bf8.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6: on a 6+ it explodes, and every unit within 3" of it suffers 1 mortal wound. Make this roll before you remove the model from the battlefield and before any embarked models disembark.

33696ca1ce3f.name: Naturally Stealthy
33696ca1ce3f.plain: Ranged attacks made against this unit subtract 1 from their hit roll. When a ranged attack is allocated to one of its models while it is receiving the benefits of cover, add a further 1 to armour saving throws against that attack.

3554bc2f806c.name: Demolition Vehicle
3554bc2f806c.plain: The bearer can be chosen to shoot even while it is within Engagement Range of enemy units, and can then make attacks with its Cyclops demolition charge. When this unit shoots with its Cyclops demolition charge, you must target every other visible unit in range, friendly and enemy alike, and resolve attacks against each of them, even if those units are within Engagement Range of models from an opposing unit. Once this unit has shot with its Cyclops demolition charge, it is destroyed. This model also can't control objective markers or perform actions.

3727db6aa7e9.name: Heavy bomb
3727db6aa7e9.plain: Once per turn, a bearer with at least one heavy bomb left can drop one. Straight after the bearer moves, you can pick a point on the battlefield that it moved over this phase. For every unit within 6" of that point, roll a D6, subtracting 1 when that model is a CHARACTER (excluding VEHICLE and MONSTER units). On 4-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 6, it suffers D6 mortal wounds. No heavy bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. Since a January 2023 update, the aircraft must still be on the battlefield after finishing its move for this to work.

3823f910ee24.name: Larkin's Long-Las
3823f910ee24.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking a target for this weapon. Attacks made with it that get an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflict D3 mortal wounds on the target as well as the normal damage.

3a2c83e1f43c.name: Weapons Team
3a2c83e1f43c.plain: Models in this unit count as Heavy Weapons Team models when embarking within TRANSPORTS.

3e7a0e4f0962.name: Lascutter
3e7a0e4f0962.plain: When the bearer fights, it can make at most 1 attack with this weapon.

3fead98543a0.name: Death Rider Hunting Lance
3fead98543a0.plain: If the bearer's unit made a charge move this turn, melee attacks made with this weapon have Strength +2, Armour Penetration -3 and Damage 2.

413abe25a99c.name: Wall of Muscle
413abe25a99c.plain: When an attack is allocated to this model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1, to a minimum of 1.

4148d907c88d.name: Colonel-Commissar Ibram Gaunt
4148d907c88d.plain: If Colonel-Commissar Ibram Gaunt is in this unit, it automatically passes every Morale test it takes.

4636137aa287.name: Shield of Faith
4636137aa287.plain: In each enemy Psychic phase, Gotfret de Montbard can try to deny one psychic power like a PSYKER, but he rolls a single D6 instead of 2D6. The power is resisted if that roll beats the result of the Psychic test that manifested it.

47084438d0de.name: Grav-chute Insertion
47084438d0de.plain: At any point during this vehicle's move, models can disembark from it, but if they do, they can't move again this phase. If the Valkyrie has moved 20" or more, roll a D6 for each model that disembarks; on a 1, it is slain. Models disembarking like this must be set up more than 9" away from all enemy models.

47a400cd34eb.name: Colonel Colm Corbec
47a400cd34eb.plain: Once per battle round, if Colonel Colm Corbec is in this unit and this unit uses an Astra Militarum or Core Stratagem, that Stratagem costs 1 CP less to use (minimum 0 CP). The reduction applies only to that one use; later uses cost the normal amount.

47c4078dcb88.name: Emergency Plasma Vents
47c4078dcb88.plain: Hit rolls of 1 with this model's supercharged plasma cannon don't automatically destroy it; instead it suffers 1 mortal wound for each 1 rolled. Those mortal wounds are suffered once all of the weapon's shots have been resolved.

4982dbd2529d.name: Explodes (4+/6"/D6)
4982dbd2529d.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 4+, every unit within 6" of it suffers D6 mortal wounds as it explodes.

49f20baf2abc.name: Explodes
49f20baf2abc.plain: When this TRANSPORT model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you remove it from play. On a 6, every unit within 2D6" of it suffers D6 mortal wounds as it explodes.

4a64a5453b62.name: Flanking Manoeuvres
4a64a5453b62.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit behind enemy lines rather than on the battlefield. If you do, they arrive in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases: set them all up wholly within 6" of one battlefield edge and more than 9" from enemy models.

4a9fbde35d47.name: Storm Troopers
4a9fbde35d47.plain: On an unmodified hit roll of 6, attacks made by models in this unit score an extra hit.

4ca385fa526f.name: Breacher Charge
4ca385fa526f.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability. The bearer can shoot each breacher charge it has only once per battle.

4cbb904cb33f.name: Memento Mori
4cbb904cb33f.plain: Whenever this model would lose a wound, roll a D6; on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

4ea458d7480b.name: Ecclesiarchy Battle Conclave
4ea458d7480b.plain: In a Battle-forged army, this unit takes up no slots in a Detachment that includes any MINISTORUM PRIESTS.

546b420dc935.name: Compact
546b420dc935.plain: This model can embark within ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT models, and disembark from them, as though it were an INFANTRY model; it takes up the space of 6 models. In a turn in which it disembarks, it can't shoot.

5804ee24a1ab.name: Firing Deck
5804ee24a1ab.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can choose one unit embarked within this Transport model to shoot; it measures distances and draws line of sight from any point on this Transport model. Embarked units count as having made a Normal Move, Advanced or Fallen Back this turn if this Transport model did so. While any enemy units are within Engagement Range of this Transport model, embarked units can't shoot, except with Pistols.

5823e2994db3.name: Goad Lance
5823e2994db3.plain: Attacks made with this weapon score an extra hit on each successful hit roll. If an attack made with this weapon is allocated to a VEHICLE model, the unit of that model also suffers 1 mortal wound on top of any normal damage.

594c13033a1f.name: Death Korps
594c13033a1f.plain: Attacks made against this unit always fail on an unmodified wound roll of 1-2, regardless of any abilities of the attacking weapon or model.

5b7fed736f81.name: Master Vox
5b7fed736f81.plain: When an OFFICER in the bearer's unit issues an order to one of your VOX-CASTER units, you can extend that order's range to 24". The bearer also gains the VOX-CASTER keyword. All other rules for issuing orders still apply.

5d8eace182f8.name: Artillery Commander
5d8eace182f8.plain: In your Command phase, pick one enemy unit that is visible to this model and within 30" of it. Until the start of your next Command phase, when one of your ASTRA MILITARUM ARTILLERY models makes a ranged attack against that unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

5dd292f9aee7.name: Master Sniper Hlaine Larkin
5dd292f9aee7.plain: If Master Sniper Hlaine Larkin is in this unit, whenever a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, the target gets no benefit of cover against it.

5e5e53fbd6e4.name: Track Guards
5e5e53fbd6e4.plain: A vehicle with track guards always uses its starting number of Wounds to determine its Move characteristic. As a result, its Move characteristic doesn't drop as it suffers wounds.

5ff1b0b8caaf.name: Implacable Officer (Aura)
5ff1b0b8caaf.plain: At the start of the Morale phase, pick one of your KRIEG units within 6" of this model. That unit automatically passes Morale tests until the end of the phase.

621c2cbd542d.name: Munitorum Restrictions
621c2cbd542d.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, no Detachment in it can include more TAUROX PRIME models than it has MILITARUM TEMPESTUS INFANTRY units.

630e456f61ca.name: Tempestor Command Rod
630e456f61ca.plain: The bearer knows Prefectus Orders as well as Regimental Orders, but it can issue Prefectus Orders only to TEMPESTUS SCIONS units. When it does, any other units you pick through the Regimental Tactics ability to also be affected by that Order must be your TEMPESTUS SCIONS units within 6" of the unit the Order was first issued to.

6345f35535ca.name: Hunting Lance - Frag Tip
6345f35535ca.plain: Attacks made with this weapon profile score 2 extra hits on each successful hit roll.

63c86c3c3896.name: Artillery Battery
63c86c3c3896.plain: When this unit is first set up on the battlefield, all its models must be within 6" of each other; after that, each model counts as a separate unit. Any crew this model has are ignored for all rules purposes.

6561d2053ec8.name: Catachan Sergeant
6561d2053ec8.plain: You can never choose this model as your WARLORD.

66fd8f41f6aa.name: Reinforced Construction
66fd8f41f6aa.plain: If a model is receiving the benefits of cover from this terrain feature when a ranged attack is allocated to it, worsen that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 (minimum 0).

6bee7ccee35c.name: Horse Masters
6bee7ccee35c.plain: Any or all modifiers to this unit's Move characteristic, Advance rolls and charge rolls can be ignored.

6cd7a89d0312.name: Medi-pack
6cd7a89d0312.plain: Roll a D6 whenever a model in the bearer's unit would lose a wound; on a 5+, that wound isn't lost. The bearer also gains the MEDIC keyword.

6d5e13c97193.name: Mindlock
6d5e13c97193.plain: While this unit is within 6" of any of your ASTRA MILITARUM ENGINESEER models, its models have Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill 4+ and Leadership 9. Also, if your army is Battle-forged, a Detachment can include one MUNITORUM SERVITORS unit for every ASTRA MILITARUM ENGINESEER model in it, without that unit taking up a Battlefield Role slot.

6ee35947f7de.name: Loner
6ee35947f7de.plain: You can never choose Sly Marbo as your Warlord.

706b6574a859.name: Lord Castellan's Fury
706b6574a859.plain: After this model issues an Order to a unit, that unit gains this until the start of your next Command phase: when its models make ranged attacks, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of those attacks. Only the unit originally given the Order benefits; other units that the Order also affects through the Regimental Tactics ability do not.

72188544c281.name: Senior Officer (Aura)
72188544c281.plain: Aura: while one of your ASTRA MILITARUM CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 when making attacks.

736591114fcf.name: Trooper 'Try Again' Bragg
736591114fcf.plain: Trooper 'Try Again' Bragg ignores the hit roll penalty for moving and firing a Heavy weapon in the same turn. Also, in the Shooting phase, once this unit has resolved its attacks, if Trooper 'Try Again' Bragg's autocannon scored no hits, this model can immediately shoot its autocannon again.

78e81c8065ba.name: Like Fighting a Shadow
78e81c8065ba.plain: At the end of the Fight phase, once per battle, you can take this unit off the battlefield. If you do, then in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, place this model anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. If it is not on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

78f0f1197697.name: Servo-arm
78f0f1197697.plain: Each time this model fights, it can make only one attack with each servo-arm. Subtract 1 from the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon.

7b0acfdc24d6.name: Galvanic Motor
7b0acfdc24d6.plain: Whenever this unit Advances, its models gain a 5+ invulnerable save until the start of your next Movement phase.

7c09e8ff05de.name: Aeronautlca Commander
7c09e8ff05de.plain: In your Command phase, pick one enemy unit that is visible to this model and within 30" of it. Until the start of your next Command phase, when one of your AERONAUTICA IMPERIALIS models makes a ranged attack against that unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

7ce31922f293.name: Savage claws
7ce31922f293.plain: When the bearer fights, it makes 2 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can't make more than 2 attacks with this weapon.

7ed2640df952.name: Righteous Rhetoric
7ed2640df952.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ASTRA MILITARUM CORE or ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY CHARACTER units within 6" of this model and roll a D6. On a 3+, choose one of these effects, which lasts until the start of your next Command phase: (a) add 1 to that unit's charge rolls, and you can re-roll the hit roll for melee attacks made by its models; or (b) the unit's models have a 6+ invulnerable save and can't be affected by Malediction psychic powers; any Malediction powers already affecting them stop applying to those models straight away.

803a29d8ae9f.name: Servant of the Imperium
803a29d8ae9f.plain: Putting Gotfret de Montbard in an ASTRA MILITARUM Detachment doesn't stop the other units in it from gaining a Regimental Doctrine. Gotfret de Montbard himself can never benefit from a Regimental Doctrine.

81b4336adc86.name: Scything Momentum
81b4336adc86.plain: If this unit made a charge move this turn, then in the Fight phase its models add 2 to their Strength characteristic until that phase ends.

8313b82341c3.name: Terrain Feature
8313b82341c3.plain: Once this model has been set up, it counts as an Obstacle Terrain feature with these terrain traits: Defence Line, Light Cover, Heavy Cover and Defensible.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

854b792815c3.name: Stormsword Siege Cannon
854b792815c3.plain: This weapon has the Blast and Turret Weapon abilities. The target of attacks made with it gets no benefit of Light Cover against them.

8606fcdbe198.name: Summary Execution
8606fcdbe198.plain: Once per turn, if one of your ASTRA MILITARUM CORE units within 6" fails a Morale test, this model can make it pass every Combat Attrition test that phase. That unit must be within 6" of this model when it fails the test, and every Combat Attrition test taken for it is then passed automatically until the end of the phase.

86e246a9e555.name: Voice of Command
86e246a9e555.plain: In your Command phase, ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICERS in your army can issue Orders. Orders come in three types: Regimental, Prefectus and Mechanised. Each OFFICER's datasheet says, in its Commanding Authority section, which types of Orders that OFFICER knows and how many it can issue each turn. Whenever an OFFICER issues an Order, pick one of the Orders it knows. You may pick an Order that another of your OFFICERS has already issued this turn, but a single OFFICER can't try to issue the same Order more than once in a battle round. Then pick the unit that receives it: for a Regimental or Prefectus Order, one of your PLATOON units within 6" of that OFFICER'S unit; for a Mechanised Order, one of your SQUADRON units within 12" of that OFFICER'S unit. That unit is now affected by the Order. A unit can be affected by only one Order at a time; if a unit already affected by an Order is picked for another one, the new Order replaces the old one straight away.

waive.6\": the official text drops the inch mark ("within 6 of that OFFICER'S unit"); the range is 6", as the Library's range-extending text ("instead of within 6\"") confirms
waive.12\": the official text drops the inch mark ("within 12 of that OFFICER'S unit"); the range is 12", as the Library's range-extending text ("instead of within 12\"") confirms

8c2b551f7d6c.name: Engineer Weapons Team
8c2b551f7d6c.plain: An Engineer Weapons Team counts as a Heavy Weapons Team when working out transport capacity.

92235bcc8672.name: Vox-caster
92235bcc8672.plain: The bearer gets the VOX-CASTER keyword.

9538b28a6e56.name: Ripper Pistol
9538b28a6e56.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking a target for this weapon. On an unmodified wound roll of 6, attacks made with it inflict a mortal wound on top of any normal damage.

965179ab285e.name: Acts of Faith (Gotfret)
965179ab285e.plain:
Your army gets Faith Points to spend on Acts of Faith, special effects that units with this ability can attempt by passing a D6 Test of Faith.
You start the battle with 3 Faith Points if your army has any models with this ability, plus 1 more for every 10 such models in it (round down). Every attempt costs one Faith Point, so with none left you can't attempt any, and each Act of Faith below can be attempted only once per battle round. To attempt one, pick a unit from your army that has the Acts of Faith ability, choose which Act of Faith it is attempting, and roll a D6 for its Test of Faith. The test fails, with no effect, if the roll is an unmodified 1 or is lower than that Act's devotion value; otherwise the Act of Faith succeeds.
Hand of the Emperor (attempt it as your Movement phase begins; devotion value 4): if it succeeds, the unit adds 3" to its Move characteristic until that phase ends.
Spirit of the Martyr (attempt it as your Movement phase begins; devotion value 3): if it succeeds, one model in the unit regains D3 lost wounds. Or, if none of its models are wounded but some have been slain, one slain model can rejoin the unit with 1 wound remaining: set it up in unit coherency and not within 1" of any enemy models, and if it can't be placed, it doesn't return.
Aegis of the Emperor (attempt it as your opponent's Psychic phase begins; devotion value 3): if it succeeds, then until that phase ends, roll a D6 whenever the unit suffers a mortal wound, ignoring that mortal wound on a 4+.
Divine Guidance (attempt it as your Shooting phase begins; devotion value 4): if it succeeds, then until that phase ends, add 1 to hit rolls for the unit's ranged weapon attacks.
The Passion (attempt it as your Fight phase begins; devotion value 5): if it succeeds, the unit can be picked to fight twice that phase rather than only once.
Light of the Emperor (attempt it as the Morale phase begins; devotion value 3): if it succeeds, the unit automatically passes Morale tests that phase.

98f490d01889.name: Explodes (Cyclops)
98f490d01889.plain: When this model is destroyed, unless that happened after it shot its Cyclops demolition charge, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 5+, every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

9bcaf6238b71.name: Vox-Caster
9bcaf6238b71.plain: The bearer has the VOX-CASTER keyword.

9d276a30f779.name: Regimental Standard
9d276a30f779.plain: The bearer gains the REGIMENTAL STANDARD keyword and an aura: your ASTRA MILITARUM CORE units within 6" of the bearer's unit re-roll wound rolls of 1. The aura ability is called Regimental Standard (Aura), and the re-roll applies to each attack a model in such a unit makes.

9d9e1aec8693.name: Hunting Lance
9d9e1aec8693.plain: A model can attack with this weapon only in a turn in which it charged.

a19f0b7cccf4.name: Warrior Elites
a19f0b7cccf4.plain: When you add this unit to your army, you can pick one doctrine that no other unit in your army has. This unit has that doctrine as well as any others it has.

waive.60: page reference (doctrine list location), not a rule value
waive.61: page reference (doctrine list location), not a rule value

a6e4d1355d5d.name: Heavy Bombs
a6e4d1355d5d.plain: Once per turn, a bearer with at least one heavy bomb left can drop one. Straight after the bearer moves, you can pick a point on the battlefield that it moved over this phase. For every unit within 6" of that point, roll a D6, subtracting 1 when that model is a CHARACTER (excluding VEHICLE and MONSTER units). On 4-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 6, it suffers D6 mortal wounds. No heavy bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. Since a January 2023 update, the aircraft must still be on the battlefield after finishing its move for this to work.

a94b7c54668e.name: Heroic Senior Officer (Aura)
a94b7c54668e.plain: Aura: while one of your ASTRA MILITARUM CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 when making attacks.

ab257178c83d.name: Dominus Triple Bombard Stationary
ab257178c83d.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability and can target units the bearer can't see. You can choose the stationary bombardment profile only if the bearer Remained Stationary in your previous Movement phase.

ac75826ad369.name: Airborne
ac75826ad369.plain: This model can't charge, only units that can FLY can charge it, and in the Fight phase it can only attack, and be attacked by, units that can FLY.

ac75a7aba24d.name: Jungle Fighters
ac75a7aba24d.plain: On an unmodified hit roll of 6, melee attacks made by models in this unit score 1 extra hit.

ada772f225e2.name: Gorgon Mortars
ada772f225e2.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability. The target of attacks made with it gets no benefit of cover to its saving throw.

b46d65f55790.name: Big Target
b46d65f55790.plain: When an attack targets this model's unit, wound rolls for that attack use this model's Toughness. Any attack allocated to a model in this model's unit must be allocated to this model, and any mortal wound suffered by a model in this unit must be suffered by this model instead.

b590804c930f.name: Explodes
b590804c930f.plain: When this model is destroyed, unless that happened after it shot its Cyclops demolition charge, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 5+, every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

b6dcc1ef298e.name: Launch Missile
b6dcc1ef298e.plain: In your Shooting phase, when this model is chosen to shoot, you can choose to launch its missile, provided that it has not launched it already, no enemy units are within its Engagement Range and its Deathstrike Target marker is on the battlefield. If you launch it, resolve the effect of this model's warhead. Godspear Warhead: roll a D6 for every unit within 3" of the marker's centre. On 2-3 the unit suffers 8 mortal wounds; on 4-5, 12 mortal wounds; on 6, 16 mortal wounds. Then remove the marker. Plasma Barrage Warhead: roll a D6 for every unit within D3+6" of the marker's centre, subtracting 1 from the roll for an INFANTRY CHARACTER unit. On 2-3 the unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds; on 4-5, 2D3 mortal wounds; on 6, D3+3 mortal wounds. Then remove the marker. Vortex Warhead: at the end of every one of your Shooting phases, while this model's Deathstrike Target marker remains on the battlefield, roll a D6 for every unit within D3+3" of the marker's centre. On 2-3 the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on 4-5, D3+1 mortal wounds; on 6, 2D3 mortal wounds. After that, roll one more D6: on 1-3, remove the marker; on 4+, it stays, but for the rest of the battle the Align Target action can't move it.

c2e398dac900.name: Explodes (6+/D6"/D3)
c2e398dac900.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before you remove it and before any embarked models disembark. On a 6, every unit within D6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

c31796215738.name: Explodes
c31796215738.plain: When a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 6, every unit within 3" of it suffers 1 mortal wound as it explodes.

c3f11db0f905.name: Explodes
c3f11db0f905.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 6, every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

c82aaa9f9df9.name: Pollitcal Overwatch
c82aaa9f9df9.plain: For every COMMANDANT and COMMAND SQUAD unit in a Detachment, that Detachment can include one COMMISSAR model that doesn't take up a Battlefield Role slot.

c8dc7beca3f2.name: Terrain Feature (Shield Sections)
c8dc7beca3f2.plain: Once this model has been set up, it counts as an Obstacle Terrain feature with these terrain traits: Defence Line, Light Cover, Heavy Cover and Defensible.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

c9666b451bc4.name: Skyfire
c9666b451bc4.plain: Ranged attacks made by models in this unit against an AIRCRAFT unit add 2 to their hit roll.

c9cf713faa52.name: Sniper rifle
c9cf713faa52.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking a target for this weapon. Each wound roll of 6+ made for it inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as its normal damage.

cb142af27ddc.name: Command Squadron
cb142af27ddc.plain: For every DEATH RIDER SQUADRON COMMANDER unit in a Detachment, that Detachment can include one DEATH RIDER COMMAND SQUADRON unit that doesn't take up a Battlefield Role slot.

cb2e35a7221b.name: Medi-pack (Aura)
cb2e35a7221b.plain: Aura: while one of your KRIEG INFANTRY units is within 3" of this model, roll a D6 whenever one of its models would lose a wound; on a 6, the wound isn't lost.

cbda430d2d31.name: Inferno Bombs
cbda430d2d31.plain: Once per turn, a bearer with at least one inferno bomb left can drop one. Straight after the bearer moves, you can pick a point on the battlefield that it moved over this phase. For every unit within 9" of that point, roll a D6, subtracting 1 when the unit is a CHARACTER (excluding VEHICLE and MONSTER units). A roll of 4+ means the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. No inferno bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. Since a January 2023 update, the aircraft must still be on the battlefield after finishing its move for this to work.

cd897a99789e.name: Shock Troops
cd897a99789e.plain: On an unmodified hit roll of 6, ranged attacks made with a lasgun or laspistol by models in this unit score 1 extra hit.

cd8eef9f22d5.name: Been There, Seen It, Killed It
cd8eef9f22d5.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll whenever this model attacks an enemy Monster unit in melee.

ce3fb2c22beb.name: Explodes
ce3fb2c22beb.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any embarked models disembark and before you remove it from play. On a 6+, every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

ceb100c36637.name: Knight Commander
ceb100c36637.plain: In each of your turns, Knight Commander Pask can use the Tank Orders ability twice. Resolve the first order's effects before you issue the second.

d1fe1699eea0.name: Storm Eagle Rockets
d1fe1699eea0.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability and can target units the bearer can't see. The bearer can shoot this weapon only 4 times per battle.

d4ace316a3e9.name: The Collegiate Astrolex
d4ace316a3e9.plain: If this model is in your army, after your opponent reveals their secondary objectives or Agendas for a battle, you can change one of your own secondary objectives or Agendas, following the usual selection rules. If you don't, or if your battle doesn't use selectable secondary objectives or Agendas, you gain 1 extra Command point at the start of the battle's first Command phase.

d6a33b610aca.name: Trampling Hooves
d6a33b610aca.plain: Once a mounted model has made its close combat attacks, you can attack with its mount: make 1 extra attack using this weapon profile.

d6fa425c69d9.name: Major Elim Rawne
d6fa425c69d9.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, if Major Elim Rawne is in this unit, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this unit. That enemy unit can't fight until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

d8574ec38ad4.name: Medical Scalpels
d8574ec38ad4.plain: Against any unit other than VEHICLE or TITANIC units, attacks made with this weapon always succeed on an unmodified wound roll of 2+.

dc9aae6033f9.name: Bullgryn Plate
dc9aae6033f9.plain: Models equipped with Bullgryn Plate have a Save characteristic of 4+.

dd692aaa500b.name: Scout Sergeant Oan Mkoll
dd692aaa500b.plain: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save while Scout Sergeant Oan Mkoll is part of it.

de779b583a2f.name: Support Vehicle
de779b583a2f.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can have this model repair one of your ASTRA MILITARUM Vehicle models within 3" of it, which then regains 1 lost wound. No model can be repaired more than once per turn. Also, if that VEHICLE model has already fired any weapons usable only once per battle, it can use those weapons one more time this battle.

df7a6d954a37.name: Explodes
df7a6d954a37.plain: When a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 6, every unit within 3" of it suffers 1 mortal wound as it explodes.

dfa8b8bc9265.name: Zealot
dfa8b8bc9265.plain: In a turn in which Gotfret de Montbard charged, was charged by an enemy unit or performed a Heroic Intervention, you can re-roll his failed hit rolls.

e041d72dcca3.name: Battlefield Repairs
e041d72dcca3.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can have this model repair one of your ASTRA MILITARUM VEHICLE models within 3" of it, which then regains D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

e301cd334532.name: Thunderous Headbutt
e301cd334532.plain: Melee attacks by this model that get an unmodified wound roll of 6 also inflict 1 mortal wound on the target, on top of any normal damage.

e5f85a04302b.name: Cold Steel and Courage
e5f85a04302b.plain: After this model issues an Order to a unit, that unit gains this until the start of your next Command phase: whenever one of its models attacks in melee, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically, unless the target is a Vehicle unit. Only the unit originally given the Order benefits; other units that the Order also affects through the Regimental Tactics ability do not.

e8786d50fb2a.name: Envenomed Blade
e8786d50fb2a.plain: Attacks made with this weapon have a Damage characteristic of 2 when allocated to a non-vehicle model.

e8c8061366ec.name: Warrior Zealot
e8c8061366ec.plain: In a turn in which this model made a charge move, was charged or performed a Heroic Intervention, you can re-roll the hit roll for its melee attacks.

eb5f0fc7e6eb.name: Explodes
eb5f0fc7e6eb.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play, adding 3 to the roll if it hasn't launched its missile (see the Launch Missile ability). On a 6+, every unit within 6" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds as it explodes.

ee7cdfd7cb6c.name: Automated Emplacement
ee7cdfd7cb6c.plain: Whenever a model in this unit shoots, choose one keyword: INFANTRY or VEHICLE. Until those shots are resolved, that model's attacks must target the closest eligible enemy unit with that keyword. If no eligible unit has either keyword, the model must target the closest eligible unit instead. This unit is never eligible to charge or Heroically Intervene, and can't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

f07bdf66dab8.name: Demoltion Vehicle
f07bdf66dab8.plain: The bearer can be chosen to shoot even while it is within Engagement Range of enemy units, and can then make attacks with its Cyclops demolition charge. When this unit shoots with its Cyclops demolition charge, you must target every other visible unit in range, friendly and enemy alike, and resolve attacks against each of them, even if those units are within Engagement Range of models from an opposing unit. Once this unit has shot with its Cyclops demolition charge, it is destroyed. This model also can't control objective markers or perform actions.

f1e5bff4165b.name: Sappers
f1e5bff4165b.plain: During deployment, if every model in this unit has this ability, you can set the unit up underground rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

f89ea5d197ac.name: Aerial Drop
f89ea5d197ac.plain: During deployment, you can put this model in a high altitude transport (ready to deploy by grav-chute) instead of on the battlefield. It can then make an aerial drop at the end of any of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

fb2920667512.name: Mindlock
fb2920667512.plain: If a Quartermaster Revenant model is part of this unit, the unit's Medicae-servitor models have Weapon Skill 4+.

fc1068ec125e.name: Artillery Tractor
fc1068ec125e.plain: In your Movement phase, whenever this model is chosen to make a Normal Move, it can tow 1 of your <REGIMENT> ARTILLERY models within 1" of it. If it does, once this model has finished its move, that ARTILLERY model can be moved to a spot on the battlefield within 12" of where it started and within 1" of this model. No ARTILLERY model can be towed more than once per turn.

waive.ARILLERY: misspelling of ARTILLERY in the official text; ARTILLERY is used

ffff85f95317.name: Recovery Vehicle
ffff85f95317.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you can have this model repair another of your <REGIMENT> VEHICLE models that is within 3" of it, which then regains up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.
